name: MTD for Income Tax deadlines
notes: Dates are as GOV.UK publishes them. GOV.UK guidance does not say a deadline moves when it falls on a weekend.

deadlines.title: MTD quarterly update 2026-27 Q1 due
deadlines.note: No penalty points for late quarterly updates in 2026-27 (HMRC).
deadlines.who: People in MTD for Income Tax that year: qualifying income over £50,000 in 2024-25

deadlines.title: MTD quarterly update 2026-27 Q2 due
deadlines.note: No penalty points for late quarterly updates in 2026-27 (HMRC).
deadlines.who: People in MTD for Income Tax that year: qualifying income over £50,000 in 2024-25

deadlines.title: First payment on account for 2026-27 due (if you make payments on account)
deadlines.note: Usually half of the previous year's bill; not needed if that bill was under £1,000 or over 80% was collected another way. MTD does not change payment dates.
deadlines.who: Self Assessment taxpayers who owe tax

deadlines.title: MTD quarterly update 2026-27 Q3 due
deadlines.note: No penalty points for late quarterly updates in 2026-27 (HMRC).
deadlines.who: People in MTD for Income Tax that year: qualifying income over £50,000 in 2024-25

deadlines.title: Second payment on account for 2026-27 due (if you make payments on account)
deadlines.note: MTD does not change payment dates.
deadlines.who: Self Assessment taxpayers who owe tax

deadlines.title: MTD quarterly update 2027-28 Q1 due
deadlines.note: A late quarterly update earns a penalty point (one per deadline, even with several businesses); at 4 points a £200 penalty, then £200 for each further missed deadline. Volunteers: no points for late quarterly updates.
deadlines.who: People in MTD for Income Tax that year: qualifying income over £30,000 in 2025-26 (plus everyone already in)

deadlines.note: MTD does not change payment dates.

deadlines.title: Tax return for 2026-27 due (online, 11:59pm)
deadlines.note: Submitted through MTD-compatible software for anyone in MTD that year. Penalty points apply to late returns.
deadlines.who: Everyone who files a Self Assessment return (through MTD software if in MTD that year)
